cohort: 12 women with von Willebrand disease (VWD) who delivered at the Hemophilia Center of Western Pennsylvania
finding: Postpartum hemorrhage occurred in one-fourth of the deliveries in women with VWD, with no difference in frequency or EBL between those who received rVWF and those who received pdVWF.
mod_finding: Postpartum hemorrhage occurred in 25% of deliveries in women with von Willebrand disease, with no difference in frequency by treatment group (recombinant VWF vs. plasma-derived VWF) or delivery type (vaginal vs. cesarean).
